_note: v6.2 region-ring board spec for build_board.py --type regionmap. Four regions on a diamond ring (North 北 top, Central 中 west, South 南 bottom, East 東 east coast) with ring edges (N-C-S-E-N) and the HSR 高鐵 spine (North<->South). v6.2 model: each region has its OWN face-down vendor deck (a DAY deck in Act I, a NIGHT deck in Act II, drinks mixed in as the low-value vendors) plus a face-down INGREDIENT market deck. Face-up VENDOR slots: North 2, the others 1 (5 vendors courtable table-wide). Each region shows its ONE signature ingredient in the shared colour + 繁體 + emblem grammar; the COMMON 糖 sugar lives in Central & South only. The vendor-claims CLOCK, Prestige track, Reputation track, token key and the 成團/遺珠 piles render as SEPARATE components (make.sh). Real illustrated Taiwan map is a bg-infodesign task. Region colours: first-pass night-market (identity.md), CVD-checked via check_access.py.
title: Travel Agents: Taiwan  —  four regions on the ring (v6.2)
notes: Ring: North–Central–South–East–North are adjacent — a Travel action moves 1 step along the ring.
HSR 高鐵: North and South also count ADJACENT (the west-coast high-speed spine).
The COMMON 糖 sugar lives in Central & South decks only; North & East source it via Convenience Store / Travel.

Cross-region recipe LOOP (the travel pull): North's 牛肉麵 needs Central 茶 · Central's 逢甲 needs South 海鮮 · South's 棺材板 needs East 米 · East's ★石板烤肉 needs North 豬肉. Every region both exports and imports its signature.
Convenience Store: draw the top card of ANY region's ingredient deck from anywhere (no travel) — the reliable way to grab the common 糖.
Start (2p): one Agent begins in North 北, the other in South 南 (opposite ends of the ring).
